transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Thank you for being here. As part of our routine planning check-in, I'd like to go around and hear from each of you before I finalize anything. Felix, could you start by stating any proposal or offer you have regarding accompanying the choir for our two spring sing-along rehearsals? Then Rosa and Gabe, I'll ask each of you in turn for any proposals or hall requirements you think are relevant. Once I've heard from all three of you, I'll make my final decision on the arrangement.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My proposal is to accompany the two rehearsals on May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00. In exchange, I'm asking for three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions from you, Inez, with no cash payment involved.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a confirmed alternative offer from pianist Dana, who would provide the same two evening rehearsals for exactly $300 cash.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to state a hall requirement: the hall's acoustic piano must be used for the choir's rehearsals, because amplified instruments and brought-in keyboards are prohibited during the choir's rehearsals.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.instrument_setup: hall's acoustic piano (brought-in keyboards and amplified instruments prohibited)

commitments.detail: Inez will provide three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions to Felix in exchange for accompanying the two rehearsals.
Felix will accompany the choir on May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00, using the hall's acoustic piano per Gabe's stated hall requirement.
